test_title: PYST 18: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below.

(Left) 325 503 158 391 144 (Right)

(Example- 697 – First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7)

(NOTE: All operations to be done from left to right.)

What will be the resultant if the second digit of the highest number is added to the first digit of the lowest number?
solution:
Given: (Left) 325 503 158 391 144 (Right)

According to the question:

 
 

 Given numbers
 325
 503
 158
 391
 144
 
 

 Number are arranged in ascending order
 144
 158
 325
 391
 503
 
 

So,

Second digit of the highest number → 5__**0**__3 → 0

First digit of the lowest number → __**1**__44 → 1

Thus, if the second digit of the highest number is added to the first digit of the lowest number then the resultant will be → 0 + 1 → 1 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
